name: Dong Hoa Lu
kicker: The open valley of Dinh Bo Linh
summary: Walk the open valley where Dinh Bo Linh first based himself, 15 km from the temples. The tourism page calls it Thung Lau or Thung Ông, a valley of about 16 mẫu with one entrance, in xã Gia Hưng. The national ranking is 1996. A gate fee was not printed.
dotReason: The first Dinh base, north of the capital temples
getThere: About 20 km north of the city, xã Gia Hưng, huyện Gia Viễn.
heroCaption: The brick hall and the cliff at Dong Hoa Lu

notice.title: This valley is not the temple ticket
notice.body: Động Hoa Lư, also Thung Lau, is in xã Gia Hưng, about 15 km from the Hoa Lu temples. The 20,000 đồng temple ticket is the Trường Yên ground. That line does not include this valley.

body: The tourism page says the name động is misleading. What you walk is an open valley of about 16 mẫu, walled by mountains, with a single entrance, a narrow gap about 30 m high. Outside that gap is đầm Cút, which the page calls a natural moat leading out to sông Đáy. The ground is xã Gia Hưng, huyện Gia Viễn, about 15 km from the Hoa Lu capital and about 20 km by road north of the city. Other names are Thung Lau and Thung Ông.

The page says this was Đinh Bộ Lĩnh's first base in the 10th century, before the capital at Hoa Lu. A small temple in the middle of the valley was first for him. Later, the page says, people moved that incense out to a communal hall shared by three communes and brought in the incense of Nguyễn Minh Không from đền Xá. The festival is the 8th of lunar month 10, smaller than the capital festival and similar in form. The Ministry of Culture and Information ranked it a national historic relic in 1996.

Walk the path to the brick hall, then the valley floor. A later promotion note describes a long stair. The tourism account of the valley gives the gap at the entrance, about 30 m high, and no step count, so the visit uses that.

gettingThere: Ride north to xã Gia Hưng. The tourism page prints about 20 km by road from the city and about 15 km from the Hoa Lu capital. Minutes were not printed.

legs.heading: From the city
legs.body: About 20 km by road north, on the tourism page. Minutes were not printed.

legs.heading: From the Hoa Lu temples
legs.body: About 15 km, on the same page. This is a different ground from the Trường Yên ticket.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
